eng_text: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Irbada birta ah waxay dul saarnataa dusha biyaha sababtoo aqeybta sare ayaa kala baxda.
eng_text: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Isjijiidka sagxadda biyaha ayaa wuxuu u dhacaa qaybaha biyaha ayaa isjiidanaayo in ka badan inta ay jiidanayaan hawada korkooda ah.
eng_text: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Biyaha atamka wuxuu ka dhigan maqaarka mid muuqda marka la eego dusha biyaha kaas oo u ogolaanyo in irbadaha ay dul saarnaadan biyaha.
eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Kabaha loogu talagalay in lagu ciyaaro ciyaaraha barafka waxay leeyahiin laba af waxna wuu u dhaxeeya. Labada af waxay u ogolaanayaan in uu qofku dhulka barafka ah si fican ugu qabto lugahiisa,xitaa qof ka marka uu dhici rabo.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Maadaama gunta safeexaddu xoogaa xoodan tahay, mar hadii safeexaddu dhinac u yara janjeedho, dhinacyada barafka taabanaya sidoo kale way xoodmaan.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Tani ayaa u keensan karto inuu iskeytka wareegto, hadday iskeytka u wareegtaan midig, qofka ayaa midig u bixi, haday iskeytka u wareegtaan bidax, qofka ayaa bidax u wareegi.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Si ay ugu noqdaan heerki tamarta hore, waa in ay iska saaran tamarta cusub ay ka heleen leerka.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Waxay sameeyaan tani iyo ku qabanaya iftiinka walax yar oo lagu magacaabo "footoon".
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Saynis yahanadu nidaamkan waxay u yaqaanaan “nidaamka isdhex galka u soo saaro fotanka” sababto ah atamka wuxuu ku sameysma iftiinka, uu sababay nidaamka iftiinka fotanka iyo iftiinka noocisa yahay shucaca.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Sawirka waxa uu tusinayaa qurubyada footoonada la sii daynayo. Hagaag, dhab ahaantii footoonadu aad bay uga yaryihiin kuwan ka muuqda sawirka.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Photons waxa ay kasii yaryihiin walxaha uu atoms-ka ka kooban yahay!
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Kadib boqolaal saacadood oo shaqo ah fiilada nalka ugu dambayn way gubataa, nalkana ma sii shaqeeyo.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Nalku markaas in la baddalo ayuu u baahan yahay. Waa muhiim inaad ka taxaddarto beddelista nalka.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Marka ugu horeysa, badhanka leedhka waxa uu u bahan yahay in la damiyo ama korantada laga jaro.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Tani waa sababta oo ah korantada ku qulquleysa godka meesha qaybta biraha ku fadhida ay ku siin karto shoog koronto oo daran haddii aad taabato gudaha galka ama gunta birta inta ay wali qeyb ka tahay godka.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Xubinta ugu weyn ee habka wareega dhiiga waa wadnaha, kaasoo bamgareeya dhiiga.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Dhiigu wuxuu kazoo baxaa wadnaha isoo dhexmara qasabado la dhaho artariis wuxuuna kusoo noqdaa wadnaha isagoo usii mara qasabado la dhaho fiinis. Qasabadaha ugu yaryar waxaa la dhahaa kaabilariis.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Ilkaha taraysaratoobku may burburin karayn uun caleemaha oo keliya balse laamaha aadka u adaga iyo xiddidaba way burburin karayeen.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Saynisyahanada qaar ayaa qaba in Taraysebatoobisku cuni jireen Seykaadhyada, kuwaasoo ahaa nooc geedo ah oo caan ahaa Kiritishiyaaskii.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Dhirtan ayaa u eg geedka qumbaha oo yer, oo leh caleen yar oo af leh.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Taraysatoobyadu waxay afkooda dhuuban ee xooggan u adeegsan kari jireen inay ku diirtaan caleemaha ka hor intanaay cunin jiradda.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Saynisyahano kale ayaa ku dooda in dhirtaas aad u sun badan yihiin markaas aanay suurtogal ahayn in dhaynasooradu cuni jireen, in kasta maanta islooska iyo xaywaano kale sida baqbaqaaqdu (ubadkii dhaynasoorada) ay cuni karaan caleemo iyo miro sun ah.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Sidey awooda jiiditaanka Io igu jiidi kartaa aniga? Hadaad istaagto sagxadda lo, culeyskaada ayaa ka yeraan intuu ahaa markaad joogtay Aduunka.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Qofkii cabirkiisu yahay 200 pound (90kg) dhulka ayaa waxa uu cabirkiisa noqonaaya 36 pound (16kg) marka la joogo lo. sidaa darted hoos u jiidka, dabcan si yar ayuu hoos kuugu jiidaya.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Qoraxdu ma leh oogo ta dhulka oo kale ah oo aad isku taagayso. Qoraxdu gebigeeduba waxay ka samaysan tahay neefo, dab iyo balaasma.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Gaastu way khafiifaysa markasta oo aad bu'da qorraxda ka sii durugto.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Qaybta sare ee aynu aragno markaynu eegno qorraxda waxa la dhahaa footosphere, taasoo la macno ah "kubbad ilaysa".
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Ilaa sadax kuno sano kadib, 1610, xidag barte Galileo Galilei ayaa waxa uu ku ogaaday telescope in Venus uu leeyahay wajiyo kala duwan, sida bisha oo kale.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Inay heerku dhacaan waxa u sabab ah dhinaca Fiinas ( ama dayaxa) ee cadceeda eegaya oo qura ayaa shidma. Heerarka Fiinas waxay sii taageereen aragtidii Copernicus ee sheegaysay in meerayaashu qoraxda ku wareegaan.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Dabadeed, sannado yar ka bacdii sannadkii 1639, xiddigiye Ingiriis ah oo lagu magacaabo Jeremiah Horrocks ayaa arkay muuqaalka Fiinas.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Engiriiska ayaa helay waqti dheer oo nabad marka uu Danelaw dib u qabsaday.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Si kasta ha ahaatee 991 kii Ethelred wuxuu wajahay caqabadii ugu weyned tan iyo horaanta qarnigii Guthrum.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Hurintan waxaa hogaaminayay Olaf Trygvasson, oo ahaa Noorwiijiyaan doonayay inuu waddankiisa dib uga soo qabsado Dhaanishka
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Ka dib caqabadihii milatari ee hore, Ethelred wuxu awooday inay is fahmaan Olaf, oo ku soo laabtay Norway si uu isugu dayo inuu boqortooyadiisa ku helo guulo isku qasan.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hanguel waa alifbeetada keliya ee si ula kac ah loo iqtiraacay ee maanta si caana loo adeegsado. Alifbeetada waxa la ikhtiraacay 1444 xilligii Boqor Sejong uu xilka hayay (1418-1450).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Boqor Sejong waa boqorkii afraad ee Boqortooyadii Joseon iyo weliba mid ka mida kuwa loogu tixgelin badnaa.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Markii hore alifbeetada Hangeul waxa uu baxshay Hunmin Jeongeum, taaso la macno aha " codka saxda ah ee dadka lagu tilmaamo."
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Waxa jira aragtiyo baadan oo ku saabsan sida Sanskrit ku abuurmay. Mid ka mida waxa ku saabsan yihiin Aryan ka soo guuray galbeedka yimina Hindiya soona qaatay luuqadoodii.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskrit waa luuqad qadiiimi waxayna u dhigmi kartaa luuqadda Laatinka ee lagaga hadlo Yurub.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Buuggii ugu horreeyay ee dunida laga yaqaan waxaa lagu qoray Sanskrit. Isku-gaynta Upanishads-ka kadib, Sanskrit wuu baaba'ay darajo-saraysiinta awgeed.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sankrit waa luuqad adag oo qani ah, taasoo luuqada badan oo casri oo Hindiya laga isticmaalo ka yimaadeen, sida Laatiinku u yahay halka luuqadaha Reer Yurub ka yimaadeen sida Faransiiska iyo Isbaanishka.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Markii dagaalkii Faransiisku dhamaaday, ayuu Jarmalku bilaabay inuu isu diyaariyo inuu weeraro jasiiradda Ingiriiska.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Jarmalku weerarku wuxu kood ahaan ugu baxshay " Hawlgalka Sealion". Hubkii cuslaa iyo aarmigii ciidamada Ingiriiska intooda badani waxay ku lumeen markii ay ka soo baxayeen Dunkirk, markaas ciidanku xoogaa daciif buu ahaa.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Balse Ciidanka Badda Ingiriisku weli wuu ka xoog badnaa ka Jarmalka ee badda ("Kriegsmarine") waxaanu burburin karayay weerar kasta oo uga soo gudba Kanaal Ingiriiska.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Hase ahaate, wax aad u yar oo maraakiibta dagaalka Ingiriiska ah ayaa ka ag dhawaa waddooyinka weerarka laga soo qaadayo maadaama taliyayaasha ciidamada baddu ka baqayeen inay maraakiibtooda dejiyaan weerarada cirka ee Jarmalku.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Aynu ku bilowno sharraxaada qorshayaasha Talyaaniga. Talyaanigu guud ahaan waxa uu Jarmalka iyo Jabbaan u ahaa “walaalka yar”.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Waxay lahaayeen ciidan lugeed iyo badeed daciifa, in kastoo ay dhisteen afar markab oo cusub wax yar ka hor bilowga dagaalka.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Yoolasha waawayn ee Talyaanigu waxay ahaayeen waddamada Afrika. Si ay waddamadaas u qabsadaan, waxay u baahanayeen meelo ay ciidamada ka soo kiciyaan, si ciidamadu u badmaaxi karaan badda Midhatareeniyanka oo u weerari karaan Afrika.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Arinta darted, waxee ku qasbanayen in iska saaran saldhigyada Biritishka iyo maraakibta Masaarida. Marka laga reebo ficiladaa, maraakiibta dagaal ee Talyaniga lama rabin in ay sameyan wax kaleeto
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Hadda iyo Jabaan. Jabaan waxaa uu ahaa dal jasiirada, sida Biritan oo kale.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Gujisyadu waa maraakiib loogu talo galay inay biyaha hoostooda socdaan, oo ay halkaas joogaan waqti dheer.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Gujisyada waxa loo adeegsaday Dagaalkii Koobaad iyo Labaad ee Aduunka. Berigaas aad bay u gaabin jireen tiirada toogashadooduna way xaddidnayd.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Bilawgi dagaalka waxa ay inta badan ku safri jireen bada dusheeda, laakin sida uu raaderku uu uso baxay una noqday mid leysku haleyn karo, gudis yada waxa ay ku qasbanaadeyn in ay biyaha hoostoda jeexan si ay uuga fogaadan in la arko.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Doomaha gujiska ee Jarmalka waxa loo yaqaanay U-boats. Jarmalku aad bay ugu wacnaayeen hagista iyo ku shaqaynta gujisyadooda.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: sababtoo ah guushooda maraakiibta quusa, ka dib dagaalka Germanka ayaa luugu aamini waayay
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Haa! Boqor Tutankhamun, oo mararka qaar loo yaqaanay “Boqor Tut” ama “ Wiilkii Boqorka ahaa” waa mid ka mid ah boqorada ugu caansana boqoradii Masaarida xilligan casriga ah.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Xiiso leh, looma tix gelin inuu aad muhiim u yahay xiliga waqtiqa badan laga joogo sidoo kale laguma diwaan gelin liiska boqorka waqtiga la soo dhafay.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Hase ahaatee, helistii la helay qabrigiisa 1922 ayaa caan ka dhigtay. In kastoo qabriyo badan horey loo boobay, qabrigan waxa laga tagay isagoon la taaban.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Badiyaa shayyada lagu aasay Tutankhamun ayaa si fiican loo dabolay, waxaana ku jiray kumanaan cadaymod oo laga keenay birihii hore iyo sidoo kale dhagxaantii.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Soo saaristii taayirada giraanta ah ayaa gaari-farasyadii Asiiriyaanka ka dhigtay qaar fudud, dheeraynaya oo u diyaarsan inay ka dheereeyaan gaari farasyada kale iyo askarta.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Fallaadhaha ka soo dhacaya qaansooyinkooda isku tallaabta ah ayaa ka dhex dusi karayay gaashaanka iyo diracyada askarta ka soo horjeeda. Abbaaro 1000 Ciise Ka hor., ayay Asiiriyaanku soo saareen fardoolaydii ugu horreysay.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Fardoolay waa ciidan ku kor dagaalama fardaha guudkooda. Kooraha weli lama ikhtiraacin, markaan fardooladii Asiiriyaanku waxay ku dagaalami jireen fardaha oo caddaysimo ah.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Waxanu naqaana siyaasiyiin badan oo ka soo jeeda Greek, sayni yahaano iyo farshaxano. Qof ka loogu aqoon badan yahay dhan ka dhaqanka waa Homer, waana halyeeyga gabayada kaas oo isu keena aqoonta Greek ga: gabayadiisa Iliad iyo Odyssey.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocles iyo Aristophanes waxay weli yihiin riwaayad sameeyayaal caan ah riwaayadahoodana waxa loo aqoonsan yahay inay yihiin kuwa ugu fiican sugaanta caalamka.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Nin kale oo caan ah oo Giriig ahi waa Xisaabiya Baytogaraas, kaaso si wayn loogu yaaano aragtidiisii caanka ahayd ee xiriirka ka dhexaysiin jirtay dhinacyada saddex xagalka.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Waxa jira qiyaaso kala duwan oo sheegaya inta qof ee ku hadla Hindiga. Waxa lagu qiyaasaa inay tahay inta u dhexaysa luuqadda labaad iyo afraad ee loogu hadalka badan yahay adduunka.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Tirada dadka luuqadda u dhashay way kala duwan tahay iyadoo ay ku xiran in la tiriyo lahjadaha aadka ugu dhow ama in kale.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Qiyaasta xajmiga l 340 milyan ilaa 500 milyan oo hadle iyo inta ugu badan 800 milyan ayaa fahmi kara luuqada.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Afka Hindiga iyo Urduga ayaa ereyadooda aad isugu dhaw laakin ku kala duwan qoraalka; wada hadalka maalin walbo, dadka ku kala hadlaayo labada luuqad ayaa isfahmi karaa.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Qarniga 15aad, waqooyiga Estonia ayaa ku jirtay saamaynta culus ee dhaqanka Jermanka.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Qaar ka mida wadaadada Jarmalka ayaa rabay in ay Ilaahey usoo dhaweeyan dadka, sida darted waxa ay hal abuureyn luuqada Estonian-ka.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Waxay ku salaysnayd alifbeetada jarmalka hal xarfan " O/o" ayaa lagu daray.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Muddo ka dib, kelmado badan oo laga soo ergistay Jarmalka ayaa is dhalan rogay. Tani waxay ahayd bilowguu ilbaxnimada.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Dhaqan ahaan, dhaxal sugah kursigu waxa si toos ah u aadaya milatariga ka dib markuu dhammaysto dugsiga.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Si kasto ay ahaato, Charles wuxuu tagay jamacada Trinity College, Cambridge halkaas uu ka soo bartay barashada bini’adamka iyo dhaqan kooda marka dambena wuxu bartay tariikhda isago heley 2:2 (heerka hoose ee fasalka heerka kuwaaad)
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles waxa uu ahaa xubinkii ugu horeeyay ee qoyska Boqortooyada Ingiriiska ka mid ah ee la siiyo shahaado jaamacadeed.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Dhanka Yurub ee Turki (Bariga Thrace ama Rumelia ee jasiiradda Balkan) ayaa ka qayb ah boqolkiiba 3% ee wadanka.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Dhulka Turkigu waxa uu dhererkiisu ka badan yahay 1,600 kilomitir (1,000 mi) ballaciisuna 800 km (500 mi), kaasoo ku dhawaad leh qaab laydi.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Cabirka turkiga, marka lagu daro lagaha, waxuu ku fadhiya 783,562 iskuweer kiilomitir (300,948 sq mi), intaaso 755,688 iskuweer kiilomitir (291, 773 sq mi) ay ku jirto koonfur galbeed Asia iyo 23,764 iskuweer kiilomitir (9, 174 sq mi) ay ku jirto Yurub
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Goobaha Turkey waxay sameyeynayaan aduunka 37 aad inta ugu badan wadanka waana cabirka Metropolitan France iyo United Kingdom la isu keenay.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turkey waxaa ku wareegsan bado saddexda dhinacba: Bada Aegean dhanka galbeedka, Bada Madow dhanka waqooyi iyo Bada Dhexe ee dhanka konfurta.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxembourg wuxuu leeyahay taarikh dheer laakin xoriyadeedu waxay ku beegantahay 1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Qaybaha ku cusub Biljamka ayaa ahaa qayb kamida Luxembourg berigii hore lakiin waxay noqdeen Biljam intii ka danbaysay 1830 maadkii kadib kacdoonkii Biljamka.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: 1957 dii ayay Luxembourg noqotay xubintii aasaastay ururka maanta loo yaqaano Midowga Yurub.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong waa difaac bur buray, mowlaca budiiska ee qeybaha kore ee dagmada Paro (xaafadda Phondey).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Waxa la sheegaa in 1649 kii, uu Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel uu sameeyay qalcadda si uu ugu xuso guushii u ka guulaystay xoogagii Tibetan-Mongol.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: 1951 kii, ayaa dab waxooga asaartii Drukgyal Dzong ah oo qura soo reebay, sawirkaas oo kale ayuu lahaa Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Dabka ka dib, qalcadda waa la ilaaliyay oo la daryeelay, waxaanay noqotay meelaha dalxiiska ee ugu fiican Bhutan.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Intii lagu jiray qarnigii 18aad ayay Kamboodiya is aragtay iyadoo dhexda ugu jirta laba deris oo awood badan, Taylaan iyo Fiitnaam.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Thais wuxuu weeraray Cambodia dhawr jeer intii lagu jiray qarnigii 18aad iyo 1772 waxay burburiyeen Phnom Phen.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Sanadkii ugu danbeye ee qarnigii 18aad Vietnamese-ka waxa ay galeen Cambodia.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Saddexdi muwaddin oo Venezuela oo shaqayso labo ayaa ka shaqayso qaybta adeega, afartiiba hal ayaa ka shaqeeyaa warshadaha, shantiiba meel na waxay ka shaqeeyaan beeraha.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Sanad walbo xiliyada Oktoobar, ku dhawaad 1.5 milyan ee xayawaanka dhirta cuno ayaa u safro bannaanada koonfurta, iyagoo goynaayo Wabiga Mara, oo ka soo goynaayo buuraha waqooyi iyagoo soo raacayo roobka.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Gobolka Serengeti waxa uu ka kooban yahay Barxadda Sarengeti, Ngorongoro Conservation Area iyo Maswa Game Reserve ee ku taal Tanzania iyo Maasai Mara National Reserve oo ku taal Kenya.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Barashada abuurista saxaafad falgal leh waxay u baahan tahay xirfado casriya iyo kuw qadiimi ah labadaba, iyo sidoo kale tuulal lagaga soo dhalaalo fasalo is dhexgal ah ( farsamaynta sawiro, codad iyo muuqaalo, iyo sheeko soo gudbin, iwm.)
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Naqshada isla jaanqaadaysa waxay u baahan tahay inaad dib u eegto fikradahaaga ku aaddan saxaafada oo aad barato inaad u fikirto qaab aan toos ahayn.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Naqshadaha isku dhex jira waxay u baahan yihiin in waxyaalaha mashruucu ka kooban yahay isku xirxiran yihiin, balse gaar ahaana ay macno sameynayaan.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Faa’iido la’aanta muraayadaha zoomka ayaa ah in adkaanta focal iyo tirada walxaha muraayadaha loo baahan yahay in la gaaro dherer kala duwan oofocal ah ay aad ugu weyn tahay tan muraayadaha indhaha.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Tani mushkiladnimadeedii way sii yaraanaysaa maadaama soo saarayaashu bikaacyo tayo sare leh soo saarayaan.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Tan ayaa u sahashay bikaacyada soo dhawaynta inay soo saaraan sawiro tayadooda la barbar dhigi karo kuwa ay sameeyaan bikaacyada diiradda xaddidan leh.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Faa'iida darrada kale ee bikaacyada soo dhawaynta waxa ka mida in daloolka ugu wayn (xawaaraha) bikaacu inta badan hooseeyo.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Qasri dhaqameedkan waqtiyadii dhexe waxa muddo badan soo jiitay khayaalka, isagoo isku darsaday sawiro baasheyaal, casho sharafeedyo dagaal fardeed Arsuureed.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Xitaa taagnida dhexdhexaadka ah, kumanaan sano da’ah waxay babi’in karta waa ay fududa tahay in la geliyo maskaxdaada codadka iyo urta tartan ka dhacay, iyo in la maqlo qoobka fardaha iyo urta baqdinta ka soo baxeysa godadka waa weyn.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Laakin miyuu khayaal abuurkeen ku salaysan yahay xaqiiqadda? Sidee khasriyadda loo dhisay marka hore? Sidee loo qaabeeyey oo hadan loo dhisay?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Isagoo noocii xiligaas ah, Qasriga Kirby Muxloe intuu guri qalcadaysan yahay baa ka badan intuu qasri dhaba yahay.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Daaqadaheeda weyn ee muraayadaysan iyo gidaarka dhuuban wakhti badan ma aynan celin karin weerar joogto ah.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Isku dheelitirka awooddu waa nidaam ay ummadaha reer Yurub doonayeen in ay ku ilaashadaan madax-bannaanida qaran ee dhammaan gobollada Yurub.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Fikradu waxay ahayd in dhammaan waddamada Reer Yurubku ay waddan ka ilaaliyaan inuu awood bato, sidaa daraadeed dawladuhu waxay inta badan beddelanayeen iskaashiyada si ay isu dheelitiranka u ilaaliyaan.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Dagaalkii Awood-wareegga ee Isbaanishka (Spanish Succession) wuxuu noqday dagaalki ugu horeeyay ee qadiyadda ugu weyn ahayd dheellitirka awoodaha.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Tani waxay muujisay isbeddel muhiima, maadaama awoodda Reer Yurubku aanay mar danbe isu soo dhigi karin dagaalo diimeedyo. Sidaa daraadeed, Dagaalkii Soddonka Sanno ayaa noqonaya dagaalkii ugu dambeeyay dagaal diimeed lagu magacaabo.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Macbadkii Artemis ee Efesos waxaa la burburiyey 21-kii Luulyo, 356 Ciise kahor ficil dab qabadsiiyay Herostratus.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Sida ay sheekadu sheegayso, dhiirigelintani caanimo ayay ahayd wax kasta ha ku kacdee. Ephesians-ku, iyagoo caraysan, ayay ku dhawaaqeen in magaca Herostratus weligii la qorayn.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Taarikhyahanka Greek Strabo ayaa ka dib ugu qoray magaca sidaan ugu naqaano maanta. Macbuudka ayaa la dumiyay isla habeenkii uu Alexander the Great dhashay.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander, boqor ahaan wuxuu ku deeqay inuu baxsho dib u dhiska macbadka, laakiin waa la diidey deeqdiisa. Ugu dambeyn, markii uu geriyoodey Alexander, dib ayaa loo dhisay macbadka markay taariikhda miilaadigu ahayd323.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Hubi inay gacantaadu u fidsan tahay sida ugu badan ee suurtogalka ah adoo waliba u haleelaya qoraalka si sax ah – sidoo kale isku day inaanad dhaqaaq dhib ah gacantaada ku samayn.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Qaabkan, waxaad daaleysaa inta ugu yare e suurtogal ah. Xasuusnoow inaanay jirin wax baahiya oo aad u qabto inaad ku cadaadiso furayaasha si aad codka u dheerayso sida biyaanada.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Foorida, si aad cod dheeraada u hesho, waxaad adeegsanaysaa tuunbooyinka oo xawaaraha iyo cadaadiska loo kordhiyay.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Suufinimadu waa raadinta la midawga, la cid noqoshada, la dhugmo-yeelashada xaqiiqda biyo kama dhibcaanka ah, runta caqiideed ee Ilaah.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Aaminuhu waxa uu la kulan toosa, hanuun, ama hidaayo ka raadsanayaa waxa uu caabudayo.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Raacdayaashu waxay qaataan hab nololeed gaar ah, ama dhaqamo loogu talo galay inay kobciyaan khibradahaas.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Suufinimada waxa lagaga garan karaa noocyada kale ee diimaha caqiidadeeda iyo caabudisteeda awooda saaraysa khibrada gaarka ah soo jeedka maskaxeed, gaar ahaan ta nabdoon, maskaxda leh, naxariista leh, ee xitaa farxada leh.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Siikhnimadu waa diin ka timi qaarad hoosaadla Hindiya. Waxay ka soo farcantay gobolka Bunjaab qarnigii 15aad iyadoo ka go'day sunnaha Hinduuga.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Siikhyadu waxay aaminsan yihiin in diintoodu ka baxsan tahay diinta Hinduuga in kastoo ay aqoonsan yihiin inay diintooda dhaqan iyo asal la wadaagto Hinduuga.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Siikhyadu diintooda waxay ugu yeedhaan Gurmata, taasoo Bunjaabiga ku noqonaysa “ wadiiqada shiikha”. Shiikhu waa mid asaasi u ah dhammaan diiimaha Hindiya balse Siikhnimadu muhiimada ka badan oo ka asaasisan bay siisay.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Diinta waxa asaasay Wadaadka Nanak qarnigii 15aad (1469-1539). Waxa ku sii xigay sagaal wadaad oo kale.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, bishii Juun 1956, ballamihii Krushchev ayaa tijaabo la mariyay ka dib mar rabshado ka qarxay Poland, oo shaqaaluhu ka mudaharaadayeen cunto yari iyo mushahar dhimis, isu beddeleen muddaharaad guud oo lagaga soo horjeedo Hanti-wadaagga.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: In kastoo ugu dambayntii, Krushchev uu soo diray taangiyo kala danbaynta soo celiya, waxa uu ogolaaday baahiyo dhaqaale oo aqbalayna inuu Wladyslaw Gomulka hii caanka ahaa u magacaabo ra'iisal wasaare cusub.
eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Ilbaxnimada Indus Valley ayaa ahaa ilbaxnimo Muddadii Naxaaska ee ku yaalay waqooyi bari ee qaarada Hindiga oo koobayay halka dawladda Baakistaan ee maaanta ku taalo iyo qayb ka mid ah waqooyi galbeed ee Hindiya iyo waqooyi bari ee Afghanistan.
eng_text: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Ilbaxnimada ayaa ku fiday agagaarka wabiga Indus, halkuu ka helay magaciisa.
eng_text: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: In kastoo culimad qaarkood ay qiyaasayaan maadaama ilbaxnimadu ka jirtay dhoobalayda wabiga hadda qallalay ee Sarasvati, ay habboon tahay in loo baxsho Ilbaxnimadii Indus-Sarasvati, iyadoo qaar kalena ugu yeedhaan Ilbaxnimadii Harappan, iyagoo ugu magac daraya Harapa, oo ahayd goobtii ugu horeysa ee aagageedii la soo fagay 1920-yadii.
eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Dabcigii milatarinimo ee boqortooyada Roomaanka ayaa caawisay kobcinta horumarka caafimaad.
eng_text: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Qorashada dhakhaatiirta waxa bilaabay Boqor Augustus waxaanay xataa noqdeen kuwii ugu horeeyay ee Ciidanka Caafimaad ee Roomaanka ee la adeegsan jiray dagaalada ka dib.
eng_text: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Qaalin sameyuhu wuxuu laha aqoon kala duwan ay ka mid tahay daawooyinka hurdada ay ka mid tahay xanuun babi’ishaya laga soo saro miraha iyo daawooyinka suuxdinta laga soo sarayo miraha dhiraha.
eng_text: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Waxay khabiir ku noqdeen xubno jarista si ay bukaanada uga badbaadiyaan gaangari iyo sidoo kale halbawla xiranka si dhiigu u qulqulo.
eng_text: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Ilaa dhowr qarni, boqortooyada Roman-ka waxa ay hor kacday guulo waaweyn ee dhanka daweynta waxa ayna aas aastay inta badan aqoonta aan maanta naqaano
eng_text: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

eng_text: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

eng_text: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Qabriga Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 ayaa laga yaabaa inuu yahay ka ugu caansan qabriyada Dooxada, waa qayb ka mid ah filimka Howard Carter's 1922 ee lagu helay xabaasha boqorka yar oo sidiisii ah.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Marka loo barbar dhigo dhismayaasha qadiimiga ah, si kastoo ay ahaataba dhismaha Tutankhamun wuu u qalmaa in la booqdo, aad buu u yaryahay sidoo kale wuxuu leeyaha qurxin fiican oo kooban.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Qof kasta oo xiiseynaya inuu arko caddaynta dhaawaca ku dhacay haraaga maydka markii la isku dayay in laga soo saaro naxashka wuu niyad jabi doonaa maadaama keliya madaxa iyo garbuhu muuqdaan.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Taajiriinta ugu sareysa xabaalaha ma sii jiri doonaaan in badan, lakin waa laga saaray Madxafka Masar ee Qahiro.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Booqdayaasha waqtigoodu kooban yahay waxa u fiicnaan lahayd inay waqtigooda meel kale ku qaataan.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, ayaa 12 kiloomiitar koonfur galbeed u jiraa Siem Reap. Macbudkan buurta korkeeda ku yaalo ayaa waxaa la dhisay qarniga 9aad markuu xukumaayay boqor Yasovarman.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Baqdinta jawiga degan macbuudka iyo eegida xaga saree buurta ee biyaha Tonle Sap waxay ka dhigeysa fulitaan keeda mid qiimo leh.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Booqashada goobta waxa sida quruxda badan la raacin karaa safar doomeed harada ah.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Angkor Pass ayaa laga rabaa si aad u gasho macbadka markaas ha ilaawin inaad soo qaadato baasboorkaaga markaad ku socoto Tonle Sap.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jerusalem waa caasimada iyo magaalada ugu weyn ee Israel, inkasto wadamada kale iyo Qaramada Midoobe aysan aqoonsanen iney tahay casimada Israel.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Magalaada qadiimiga ah ee ku taal Buuraha Judean waxay leedahay taariikh cajiiba oo soo taxnayd kummanaan sannadood.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Magalaadu waxay barako u leedahay saddexda diimood ee hal Ilaah leh – Tawaraadda, Kiristaanka iyo Islaamka, waxaanay u tahay xaruntooda diimeed, caaqiideed iyo dhaqan.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Muhiimadeeda diimeed ee wayn, iyo goobaha badan ee ku yaal aagga Magaalada Wayn daraadood, Quddus waa mid ka mida goobaha dalxiiska ugu waawayn Israa'iil.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jerusalem ayaa leh goobo badan taarikhi ah, qadiimi, iyo dhaqameed, iyo sidoo kale xaruumaha dukaakaysiga dadka ku badan yihiin, jafeeyada, iyo maqaayadaha.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ekwadoor waxay muwaadiniinta Kuuba ka rabtaa inay helaan warqad martiqaad ka hor intaanay ka soo gelin madaarada caalamiga ah ee Ekwador ama goobaha xuduuda ee lag asoo galo.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Warqaddan waa inay sharciyaysaa Wasaaradda Arimaha Dibadda ee Ekwadoor, waan inay u hogaansantaa shuruudo khaasa.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Baahiyahani waxaa loogu tala galay in lagu dajiyo dhaqdhaqaaqa qaxoontiga labada wadan.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Muwaadiniinta Kuuba ee haysata kaadhka Cagaaran ee Maraykanka waa inay aadaan Qunsuliyadda Ekowodoor si shuruuddan looga dhaafo.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Basaboor kaaga waa inu ahada mid aan dhacsanen ugu yaraan lix bilood ka hor inta aadan safrin. Safarka dhaqsaha/waqtiga dheerba waxaa la doonaya in la xaqiijiyo waqtiga aad joogeyso.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Dalxiisyadu waxay u jaban yihiin kooxaha waawayn, markaas haddaad keligaa tahay ama aad la soco hal saaxiib, isku day inaad la kulantaan dad kale una samaysaan kooxo afar ilaa lix ah si aad u heshaan kharash qofeed kan ka fiican.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Sikasto ha ahaate, tan waa inay ahaanin walaacaada maxaa yeelay dadka dalxiisayo ayaa la bedelaa si loo buuxiyo baabuurta.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Dhab ahaantii waxay badanaa u muuqataa hab dadka lagu khiyaamayo si ay lacag dheeraada u bixiyaan.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Waxa kor ka soo hadhaynaya dhamaadka waqooyi ee Machu Picchu waa buurtan dheer, oo badanaa kadaba muuqata sawir badan oo haraayada ka mida
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Waxay umuuqataa xoogaa waxyar ka yaraya hooseya, waana cago jaban oo adag, laakin dadka sida fiican macquul u ah waxay awood u yeelan karaan inay sameeyaan ila 45 daqiiqo.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Jaranjarooyinka dhagaxa ka samaysan waxa sidoo kale la dhigaa waddada inteeda badan, meelaha jiirta dheer lehna xadhko ayaa taageero ahaan u yaal.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Iyadoo sidaa tahay, filo in aad isdejiso aadna talaab talaab u marto nidaamka, gaar ahaan marka ay qoyaan noqoto waxaa laga yaaba iney noqoto qatar sida ugu dhaqsaha badan.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Waxaa qaybta kore ku ag yaalo god oo laazim ah in la dhex maro, way gaaban tahay waa na cariiri.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Daawashada goobaha iyo duurjoogta ku sugan Galapagos waxaa sifiican loogu sameeyaa dooni, sida Charles Darwin uu sameeyay sanadkii 1835 kii oo kale.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Inkabadan 60 markab raaxo ayaa ka shaqeeya biyaha Galapagos - cabir qaad kooduna gaarayo 8 ilaa 100 qof
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Dadka intooda badani booskooda horey ka sii qabsadaan ( maadaama doomuhu buuxaan badanaa inta lagu jiro xilliga mashquulka).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Iska hubi in aad hesho qof matale fican kaas oo qibrad iyo aqoon u leh jaziirada Galapagos inuu kuu jaro marakiibta kala duwan.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Tani waxay hubinaysaa in dooistaada gaarka iyo/ama caqabadahaaga lagu toosiyo markabka ugu habboon.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Ka hor intaanu Isbaanishku imaanin qarnigii 16aad, Chile ta waqooyi waxay ku hoos jirtay xukunki Inca halka dadka dhaladka ah ee Araucanians ku (Mapuche) ay ka degenaayeen badhtamaha iyo koonfurta Chile.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuche waxay sidoo kale ahaayeen qaar ka mida dadkii Amerikaanka asalka ah ahaa ee madaxa banaanaa, kuwaaso aan si buuxda loogu darin sharciga Isbaanish ku hadalka illaa iyo ka dib xornimadii Jayl maahane.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: In kastoo Jayl ku dhawaaqday madaxbanaanideeda 1810 ( intii lagu jiray dagaaladii Nabooliyan ee Isbayn ka dhigay bilaa dawlad dhexe muddo laba sano ah), guul go’aan leh lagama gaarin Isbaanishka illaa iyo 1818.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Jamhuriyada Dominican (Spanish: República Dominicana) waa wadanka Caribbean taas oo dhacda bariga qeybta jasiirada Hispaniola, taas oo la wadaagta Haiti.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Xeebabka ciida cad iyo muuqaalka buuraha ka sokow, wadanka waxaa ku yaala magaalada Yurub ugu qadiimsan qaarada America, oo hadda ka qayb ah Santo Domingo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Jasiiradda waxa ugu horrayntii degenaa Tainos ka iyo Kariibis. Kariibisku waxay ahaayeen dad ku hadla Arawakan kuwaasoo meesha yimi abbaaro 10,000 BCE.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Sanado kooban dhexdooda iyadoo la raacayo soo gadhida Yurub, shacab ka Taino waxay si aad u yareynaysaa guusha Spanish ka.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Sida laga soo xigtay Fray Bartolome de las Casas ( Tratado de las Indias) intii u dhexaysay 1492 iyo 1498 weeraryahanada Isbaanishku waxay dileen illaa 100,000 oo Taino.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardin de la Union.Meerahan waxaa loo dhisay sidii dhismayaashii qarnigii 17 aad qarnigii la dumin jiray Tempedon San Diego waa dhismaha keliya ee kabadbaaday.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Hadda waxay u shaqeyneysa sida xarunta bartamaha, iyo marlwalba ay jiraan waxbadan, malin iyo habeen.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Waxaa jiro dhowr maqaayad oo ku hareereysan beerta, galbihi iyo fiidkiiba waxa ay leedahay goobo mada daalo ee tiyaatar yaraha bartamaha.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Laba barandho oo ay u dhexeyeen keliya 69 sentimitir ayaa hoy u ah akhyaarkii waynaa ee mucaashaqa ahaa.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Lacago yar caruurta qaar way ka hadal siyaan shekoyin koda dhan.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Bowen Island waa safar maalmeed caana ama safar fasaxeed ka kooban dhir kor, buur socosho, dukaamo, hudheelo iyo qaar kaloo badan.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Bulshhadan saxda ah waxay ku nooshahay Howe Sound oo ka yara baxaab Vancouver, waxana si hawl yar loogu gaadhi kaeaa tagsi biyood ka baxa jasiiradda Grandville ee ku taal suuqa hoose ee Vancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Kuwa ku raaxaysta waxqabadka banaanka,socdaal ila Badda dariiqa Iskay waa muhim.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1.5 saacadood oo safar gaadhiyeeda u jirta Faankuufar) waa magaalo qaaliya balse aad loo yaqaano Ciyaarihii olambikada Jilaalka ee 2010 dartood.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Jiilaalka, ku raaxayso baraf ku siibadka ugu wacan Waqooyiga Maraykanka, Xagaagana tijaabi buur-baaskil ku wadiida asal ah.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Ogolaansha waa in codsadaa mar hore. Waa in aad fasax u heysata in aad habeen joogto Sirena.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena ayaa keli ah saldhigga oo laga helo jiifka degenaansho iyo cunooyin kulul oo dheer xero dhigashada. La Leona, San Pedrillo, iyo Los Patos ayaa laga helaa xero dhigashada keli oo lahayn adeega cunto.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Waxaa suurta-gal ah in si toos ah looga helo rukhsadaha barxadda xarunta Ranger ee Puerto Jiménez, laakiinse ma aqbalaan kaararka deynta
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Adeega Jardiinada (MINAE) ma bixiyo wax ogolaansho ah ee jardiinada kabadan bil kahor inta la filaayo imaanshaha.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol waxay kuu haysaa adeega sii qabsashada oo qarashkiisu dhan yahay US$30, or $10 oo maalintii ah; tafaasiishu waxay ku qoran tahay bogooda Corcovado.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Jasiiradaha Cook waa waddan jasiiradeed si xor ah ula xiriira New Zealand, kuna yaalla Polynesia, kuna dhex yaalla Koonfurta Badwaynta Baasifigga.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Waa waddan jasiiradeed ka kooban 15 jasiiradood oo ku fidsan in ka badan 2.2 km2 oo badwayna.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Iyagoo isu waqti la ah Hawaii, jasiiradaha ayaa in badan lagasoo qaadaa “Hawaii hoosteeda”.
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: In kasta oo ay yartahay, waxay xasuusineysaa qaar ka mid ah booqdayaasha waayeelka ah ee Hawaii kahor xiligii dowladnimada, jiritaan la’aanta ldhammaan hudheellada dalxiiskaA ee waaweyn iyo horumarka kaleba.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Jasiiradaha Cook maqaban magaalooyin wayn laakin waxay ka samaysan yihiin 15 jasiiro kala duwan. Kuwa ugu wayn ayaa ah Rarotonga iyo Aitutaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Waddama horumaray maanta, bixinta sariir raaxo iyo quraacdu waxaa laga yeelay qaab-farshaxan.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Kor dhamaadka, B&B sida iska cad waxa ugu weyn waa labo shey, gogosha iyo quraacda.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Waafaq ahaan, meelaha ugu wacan kuwaas qofku waxa uu ka heli karaa hurdo raaxo leh, waxaba laga yaabaa inay tahay sariir gacan ku samays ah ama mid qadiimi ah.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Quraacda waxa lagu soo dari karaa waxyaalaha xillileyda ah ama cuntooyinka marti qaaduhu ku takhasusay.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Goobta waxa ay noqon kartaa dhismo qadiimi oo taarikhiya misna leh alaab qadiimi ah, dhul aad loo qurxiyey iyo baraagta dabaasha.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Inaad gaarigaaga gasho oo waddada qabsato si aad safar u gasho waxay leedahay soo jiidasho iddeeda iyo fudayd.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Ka duwan gawadhida waa weyn, waxat hore u taqaney kaxeynta gadhigaga iyo xad kiisa.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Ka samaysashada teendho meel dhisme gaara ah ama tuulo baaxad kasta ha lahaatee ayaa si fuduud u soo jiidan karta dareen aan loo baahnayn.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Gunaanadkii, gaariga si fiican baad safar waddeed ugu gali kartaa balse way yar tahay inaad ku "xero" tagto.
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Gaadhi xero ka dhigashadu waxay suurto gal tahay hadaad haysato gaari wayn, SUV, Sedan ama Station Wagon leh kuraasi la dejiyay.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Hodheelada qaar kood waxay dhaxal u leyihiin ilaa waqtigii dahabiga ee jidadka tareenka uumiga iyo markabka xamuulka; kahor Dagaalkii Labaad ee Dunida, ee qarnigii 19aad ama 20aad.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Hoteeladan ay dadka taajiriinta iyo kuwa caanka ah degaan, ayaa inta badan lahaayeen cunto iyo baashaalka habeenka oo wacan.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Qalabka duugga ah,la’aanta adeegyadi ugu dambeeyay,iyo da’nimcooyin wanaagsan leh ayaa waliba qayb ka ah dhaqankooda.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Inkastoo gooni loo leeyahay, mar marka qaar waxa ay qaabilan madaxda iyo marti sharafyada soo booqanayo
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Safrayaasha wata lacago yar oo ku safraya aduunka waxa loo tix geliyaa iney wajihi karaan, lacagta oo ka go’da haddii ay tagaan hodheelo badan oo kuwan oo kale ah.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Shabakada isku beddelka soo dhawayntu waa urur dadka socdaalka ah ku xira dadka deggan magaalooyinka ay booqanayaan.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Kuso biirida shabakadda noocan waxay u baahan tahay foom laga soo buxiyo habka intarneetka; iyado shabakadaha qaar kood ay bixiyaan ama u bahaan yahiin cadeymo dheeraad ah.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Liis martigeliyayaasha diyaarka ah ay ku qoran yihiin ayaa lagu bixinayaa waraaq ahaan iyo/ama online ahaan, mararka qaarna waxa la socda qiimeyn ay ku sameeyeen dad kale.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing waxa la aasaasay Jannaayo 2004 ka dib markii Casey Fenton oo aa barogaraamar kumbiyuutar uu tigidh jaban ugu duulay Iceland balse uu waayay meel uu dego.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Waxa uu iimeyl u qoray ardayda jaamacada deeganka waxa uuna helay codsiyo faro badan oo hooy bilaasha.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Hodheelada ayaa ugu horreeya dadka dhalinta yar - Marti caadi ah oo ku jirta labaataneyada - laakiin inta badan waxaad sidoo kale halkaas ka heli kartaa socdaal da 'weyn.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Qoysaska leh caruur waa ay ku yar yahiin laakin hodheelo qaar way u ogolaadaan qolal gaar ah.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Magaalada Beijing ee China waxaa lagu qaban doona Ciyaarta Olympic Winter 2022, taas oo ka dhigi doonta magaladi ugu horeysay taas oo qabata xiliga xagaaga iyo jilaalka Olympic.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing waxay qaban doontaa furida iyo xidhida xaflada iyo dhacdada barafka.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Meelaha kale ee ciyaarta siibashada waxa ka mida Taizicheng oo ku taal aaga Zhangjiakou, oo ku dhawaad 220 km (140 mayl) u jira Beijing.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Inta badan macbudyadu waxay leeyihiin iid sannadle ah oo ka bilaabmaysa dhammaadka Noofambar illaa iyo badhtamaha Meey, taas oo ku kala duwan hadba jadwalka sannad kasta ee macbudka lagu saleeyey.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Xafladaha macbaddka intooda badan waxa loo dabbaal degaa iyagoo qayb ka ah sannadguurada macbadka ama ka hor dhacaya dhalashada sanamka ama dhacdo kasta oo kale ee la xiriirta macbadka.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Xafladaha macbadka Kerala waa qaar aad u xiiso badan in la daawado, iyagoo leh maroodiyo la sharxay, heesaha macbadka iyo dabbaal degyo kale.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Bandhiga Adduunku ( oo sida badan loo yaqaan Soo Bandhigista Aduunka) waa bandhig sayniseed iyo faneed caalami ah.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Wadamada ka qayb galaya ayaa joogay bandhigii farshaxanka iyo aqoonta ee qaranimada pavilions tasoo lagusoo bandhigayay xaaladaha aduunka ama dhaqanka iyo raariikhda wadankooda
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Bandhigyada Caalamiga ee Beeraha waa munasabado qaaso soo badhiga ubaxyo, xarumo geedaha lagu bero iyo wax walbo la xiriira dhirta.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: In kastoo aragtiyan ahaan uu sannadle u dhici karo ( intay waddamo kala duwan ka dhacayaan), balse dhab ahaantii uma dhici karaan.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Dhacdooyinka sida caadada waxa ay raagan inta udhaxeysa saddex ilaa lix bilood, waxaana lagu qabta dhul aan ka yareyn 50 hektar.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Waxa jira noocyo filim oo kala duwan kuwaasoo la adeegsaday sannado badan. Filimka caadiga ah ee 35 mm ( 36 by 24 mm taban) ayaana ah ka ugu caansan.
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Caadiyan si sahlan ayaa loo soo buuxiyaa markay dhamaato, waxaanay leedahay tayo sawireed u dhiganta DSLR-ta hadda.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Qaar ka mida kamaradaha filimada dhexe ayaa adeegsada nooc 6 ba 6 sm ah, ama sida sii saxan 56 ba 56 mn ah.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Tan ayaa ka dhigeysa heerka nadiif muuqaal mid kabadan afar jeer kan 35mm negatif (3136 mm2 la bar bardhigay 864).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Nolosha duurjoogtu waa mid ka mid ah hawlaha ugu adag sawir qaadaha, waxayna u baahantay isku darka nasiib wanaag, dulqaad, khibrad iyo qalab fiican.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Sawiradda duurjoogta ayaa qiimo badan la saarin, laakin sida sawiritaanka guud, hal sawir ayaa la qiimo ah kun erey.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Sawirada xayawaanada ka badana waxay u bahan yahiin kamarad afkeedu dheer yahay, inkasto shimbiraha duula iyo noolaha kale ee yaryari ay u bahan yahiin qaar kale.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Xayawaanno qalaad oo badan ayaa ay adagtahay in la helo, Jardiinadana mararka qaar waxay leeyihiin xeerar ku saabsan sawir-qaadashada loo adeegsanayo ganacsiga.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Duurjoogta ayaa noqon karo kuwa dadka ka cararo ama kuwa weeraro. Bay’adda ayaa noqon karto mid qawow, kuleyl, ama si kale ba u adag.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Aduunka waxa ka jira in ka badan 5,000 oo luuqadood, kuwaasoo ay ku jiraan in ka badan labaatan ay ku hadlaan wax ka badan 50 malyan oo qof.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Erayada qoran waxay ka fudud yahiin in la fahmo kuwa lagu hadlayo marka loo eego, sidoo kale. Tani waxay gaar u tahay xaqiiqda jeedina, taas oo ay adag tahay in lagu dhawaaqo si la fahmi karo.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Waddama dhan oo dhammaystiran ayaa si buuxda ugu hadla Ingiriisida, intaas waxa dheer inaad aqoon gaaban filan karto - khaasatan dhalinyarada.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Qiyaas, hadii ay Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican iyo Sydneysider wada fadhin laheyn hal miis iyago ku wada casheynayo maqaayad ku tala magaalada Toronto.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Waxay isku madadaalinayeen sheeooyinkii tuulooyinkooda, iyagoo ku soo gudbinayay lahjad guriyadooda iyo af suuqoodii.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Kasoo iibsashada cuntada suuqa weyn waa habka ugu raqiisan ee la quudan karo. Iyadoo aan fursad lagu karinin, inkastoo ay kala dorasho ay xadidan tahay in laga dhigo cuntada-mid diyaarsan.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Si kordhaysa ayay dukaamadu u sameysanayaan qaybo cunto kala duwan oo diyaarsan ah. Qaar ayaa xitaa leh kuleeliso ama qaab kale oo cuntada la kululaysto.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Inta badan wadamada ama dukaamada qaar waxaa jiro maqaayado laga helo, intooda badana waxa ay leeyihiin qiimoyin macquul gala.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Samee oo na wado koobiga ceymiskaada iyo maclumaadka xiriirka shirkadda caymiska.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Waxay u baahan yihiin inay muujiyaan cinwaanka emailka ee caymiska iyo lambarada caalamiga ah si loo sameeyo la talin/ogolaansho iyo codsiga mag dhawga.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Waa in aad heysata koobi kale oo ah shandada ah iyo qad intarneet ah (adigu isugu dir e-mail ahaan koobiga ama ku seef gareyso “cloud ka”).
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Hadii aad la safrayso laabtoob ama taablit, nuqul ku xeree mimorigiisa ama cajalada (taasoo khad la’aan la heli karo).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Sidoo kale sii nuqulo siyaasada/ xiriirada ah asxaabta iyo xigtada safraysa ama asxaabta guryihii ku haray ee ogol inay caawimo baxshaan.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Xayawaanka Moos (sidoo kale loo yaqaan elk) maahan kuwo dhaxal daan dansi leh, laakin waxa ay difaacayan naftooda hadde halis dareeman.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Marka dadku lo' gesida u arki waayaan xayawaan khatar yeelan kara, waxa laga yaabaa inay aad ugu dhawaadaan oo naftooda khatar geliyaan.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Cabitaanka alkakoolada eel la cabo iyado laga foganayo waxyabaha xun. Alkakoolada waxay u sameysa qof walba siyabo kala duwan, iyo adiguna in aad ogato xad kaaga waa muhiim.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Dhibaatooyinka mudada dheer ee ka dhalan karo khamro cabka badan ayee ku jiraan beerka oo dhaabacmo iyo sidoo kale indhoolnimo iyo dhimasho. Halista surtogalka ah ayaa sii korodho marka la cabo khamri oo si sharci ahayn lagu soo saaray.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Isbiirtooyinka sharci darrada ah waxa ku jira haraayo khatara sida miisanool, taasoo sababi karta indho la'aan, ama dhimasho xitaa in yar laga isticmaalo.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Murayadaha indhaha waxay ku raqiisnaan karaan wadamada kale, gaar ahaan kuwa daqligooda hooseeyo halkaas oo shaqalahoda uu jaban yahay.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Tixgali inaad guriga ku hesho baarista indhaha, gaar ahaan Hadii caymisku daboolayo, iyo inaad soo qaadato daawada si loogu kaydiyo meel kale.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Alaaboyinka sare ee aagagaas ku diyaar ah waxa laga yaabaa inay laba mushkilo yeelato; qaar waxa laga yaabaa inay yihiin koobi, halka kuwa dhabta ah ee la soo dhoofiyay ay ka qaalisan yihiin kuwa waddanka.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Bunku waa mid ka mid ah badeecooyinka loogu ganacsiga badan yahay aduunka, noocyadiisa badana waxaad ka heli kartaa gobolkaaga.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxay jira noocyo badan oo bunka adduunka looga cabbo kuwaaso u qalma in la tijaabiyo.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Faallo xarig ka degista (ama: kaanyoneerin) waa ku daadag gunta hog maran ama biyo ka buuxaanba.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Dooxo ka daadagu waxa uu iska darsaday qaybo ka mida dabbaal, fuulitaan iyo bootin -- balse waxay u baahan tahay in waxooga jirkaagu dhisnaado si aad u bilowdo ( marka loo eego dhagax korista, quusidda ama buuro ka siibashada, tusaale ahaan).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Socdaalkku waa ciyaar dibadeed ka kooban lugaynta dhul dabiici ah, iyo badanaa wadiiqooyinka socdaalka korkooda.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Maalin korista waxay la xiriirtaa masaafo ka yar hal may ilaa masaafooyinka dhaadheer ee maalin la goyn karo.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Socdaalka maalinta ee waddo sahlan la qaadayo diyaar garaw yar buu u baahan yahay, qof kasto si dhexdhexaada u caafimaad qabaana waa xiisayn doonaa.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Qoysaska leh caruur yar yar waxay u bahan yahiin iney sameeyaan diyaar garow, lakin shaqada maalin laha way fududa tahay xitaa caruur aad ka u yar yar iyo caruurta iskuul dhigata.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Caalamiyan, waxa jira ku dhawaa 200 oo urur dalxiis oo shaqaynaya. Intooda badan si madax bannaan bay u shaqeeyaan.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.
