text: Guusha Socdaallada Caalamiga ah ee Dunida, Go Running Tours ayaa leh kumanaan bixiyeyaal indhoolayaal ah oo jooga afarta qaaradood.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Xididada Tartanka Oradka Barcelona, Barcelona iyo Copenhagen tartanka Oradka Copenhagen, waa ay fududeet in lagu biro Tartanka Oradka Prague ee lagu qabtay Prague iyo meelo kale.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Waxaa jiro wax yaabo badan oo ay tahay in aad ka fiirsato inta aadan meel usafrin ama aad usafartaba.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Marka aad safreyso, waxat filata in aysan waxwalba ahaneyn sida ay ayaahin “marka guriga la joogo”. Sida ay wax u dhacaan, sharciyada, cuntada, tarafikada, qolalka, xerarka, luqada iyo wax yabaha lamid ee aad ka ugu duwan meesha aad ku nooshahay.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Kani waa wax aad mar kasta u baahan tahay inaad maskaxda ku hayso, si aad uga hortagto inaad ka caraysiiso ama niyad jabiso qaababka hawlaha deegaanka looga qabto.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Wakalaadaha safarku waxay jireen illaa iyo qarnigii 19aad. Wakiil safar ayaa caadiyan ku habboon qofka u safraya meel ka baxsan dabeecadii, dhaqankii, luuqadii hore u yaqaanay ama waddamada dakhligodu hooseeyo.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Inkasto inta badan shirkadahan ay rabaan in ay isticmaalan buug keydinta caadiga, kuwo badan ayaa ku taqasusay nuuc gooniyo safar, cabir dhaqaale iyo gooboyin.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Waxa fiicnaan lahayd isticmaalka wakiil si joogto ah kuugu soo gooya safarada la midka ah.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Fiirso safarada wakiilku ku xayaysiinayo websayd ama daaqadda dukaanka.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Hadii aad dooneysid inaad aduunka kusoo wareegtid si rakhiis ah, adigoo u tagaayo baahi, nolol, ama loolan, waxaa jiaan siyaabo aad ku samayn kartid.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Cadiyan, waxay u dhacan laba hab keliya: Waa inad shaqeyneyso marka aad safreyso ama isku day in aad soo koobto qibradada. Qodob kan wuxuu dirada sareyna hadhow.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Dadka raba inay huraan raaxada, waqtiga iyo saadaalinta, ee doonaya inay kharashaadka eber ku dhaweeyaan, ha eegaan odoroska safar ee ugu yar.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Talada ayaa qiyaasaysa in martida ay wax xadin, ay xad gudbin, ay ka qayb galin suuqa sharci darrada, ay baryootamin, ama sinaba ku isticmaalin dadka inay ka faa’idaan.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Hubinta tahribayaasha waa meesha ugu horeysa lagugu joojinayo marka aad ka soo baxdo diyaarad, Markab, ama wax kale sida gaadhiga.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Xuduudaha qaar kood tareynada waxa lagu hubiya iyado la wado tareyn ka adiguna waa in aad heysata kaar aqoonsi aan dhacsanen marka aad soo fuleyso tareynada mid ka mid ah.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Tareenada habeenkii laga seexdo, basaboorada waxa laga yaaba inuu ka aruriyo karigu si aan hurdada laguu khiyaamin.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Is diiwan gelinta ayaa shardi dheeraad ku ah hawsha fiisaha. Wadamo qaar, waa inaad ka diiwaan geliso xukunka goobta joogitaankaada iyo halkaad degantahay.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Tani waxay u baahan kartaa inaad foomka ka buuxiso booliiska maxalliga ah ama booqasho xafiisyada socdaalka.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Wadamo badan oo sharcigaas leh, hoteelada deegaaneed ayaa sameeyo diiwan gelinta (hubso inaad weydiiso).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Marxaladaha kale, kaliya kuwa jooga meel ka baxdan goobta deganaanshaha dalxiisayaasha ayaa u baahan is diwaan galin. Si kasta ha ahaatee, tani waxay sharciga ka dhigtaa mid aad u amaan badan, sidaa awgeed raadi kahor intaan gacanta lagu dhigin.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Hab naqshadaynta dhismeedka ayaa khuseeyo naqshadaynta iyo dhismada guriyaha. Hab naqshadaynta guriyaha ayaa inta badan soo jiidasho dalxiis ugu filan.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Dhismayaal badan ayaa aad ugu qurux badan in la daawado muuqaalka laga arki dhismo dheer korkiisa ama daaqad si fiican loo qaabeeyay isna waa qurux lala tacajabo.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Naqshadaynta dhismayaashu waxay si wayn u dhex gashaa fiilal kale sida magaalo qorsheynta, injineeriyadda dhismaha, sharraxaad sawirada, naqshadaynta gudaha iyo dhul naqshadaynta.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Siinta sida miiga badanaa ay qadiimi u yahiin, ma awoodi doonto in aad hesho damaashad habeen kii adigoo u safreyn Albuquerque ama Santa Fe.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ku dhowaad dhammaan kasiinooyinka kor lagu taxay waxay hayaan sharaab, dhowr ka mid ahna waxay keenaan magacyada madadaalada leh (inta badan kuwa waawayn eek u dhowdhow Albuquerque and Santa Fe).
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Ka warhay: magaalada yar waxay leedahay barar aan marwalba wanaagsaneen dadka ka soo boqanayo meelaha ka baxsan gobolka si ay ugu soo damashadan.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Hal markii loo eego, waqooyiga New Mexico ayaa dhibaatooyin badan ku qabaan ku waditaanka baaburka sarqaanka, iyo darawalada sarqaansan ayaa ku badan baararka magaalooyinka yar yar.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Farshaxanada iyo xariijimaha aan loo baahnayn ayaa loo yaqaan faygar.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: In kasto ay ka fogtahay arin casri ah, dadka intooda badan waxa ay la xiriiriyan dhalinyarada ku xad gudbaya hantida qaaska iyo tan qaranka ayagoo rinji ku buufinaya.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxa jira sawirlayaal farshaxan xirfadleh, xaflado farshaxan iyo gidaaro “sharci” ah. Sawirada farshaxan ee halkan ku jira waxay u ekaayeen sawiro.
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Tuurista boomerang waa xirfad dalxiisayaal jecel yihiin inay helaan.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Hadii aad rabto inaad barato tuurista boomarangi ku soo laabanaysa gacantaada, hubi inaad haysato boomarang ku habboon soo noqosho.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Gantaalada laga helo Ostereeliya aya dhabti kuwo aan soo laabaneynin. Waxaa wanaagsan in kuwa bilaawga aysan isku dayin in ay tuurtan ayadoo dabeyl jirto.
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Raashinka Hangi ayaa lagu kariyaa god kulul ee dhulka dhexdiisa.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Hogga waxa ama lagu kululeeyaa dhagxaan kulul oo dab laga soo saaray, ama waxa meelaha qaar kuleeliya dab dabiica ah oo dhulka hoostiisa ka soo baxa.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Foorno (hangi) waxaa badanaa loo adeegsadaa karinta qaab casho soolidda soo jireenka ah.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Meelo badan oo ka mid ah Rotorua waxay bixiyaan tamarta laga dhaliyo uumiga ee kasoo baxdaa cuntada god lagu kariyo, halka godad kale ee cuntada lagu kariyo laga soo qaadan karo tusaale ahaan Christchurch, Wellington iyo meelo kale.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail waxay leedahay laba dabaqadood oo tareen dadka ka raacaan gudaha iyo agagaarka Capetown: MetroPlus ( sidoo kale loo yaqaan Dabaqada Koobaad) iyo Metro (loogu yeedho Dabaqadda Saddexaad)
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus way ka raaxo badan tahay kana buuq yar tahay balse xoogaa waa ka qaalisan tahay, in kastoo weli ay ka jaban tahay tigidhada basaska Yurub.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Tareen walbo ayaa qabaa qaybta Metroplus iyo Metro; qaybaha Metroplus ayaa marwalbo geeska ugu dambe tareenka ku yaalan oo u dhaw Cape Town.
eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: U qaadida dadka kale - Waligaa indhahaaga ha ka qaadin boorsooyinkaaga, qaasatan markaad ka gudbayso xuduudaha caalamiga ah.
eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Waxaad ogaaneysa adiga laguu isticmaaley sidaha daroogada adigoon ogeyn, taas oo dhibaato badan kaga iman karto.
eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Tan waxaa ka mida kusugid leenka, maadama eeyada wax shiiriya la isticmaali karo daqiiqad walba ayadoo leys ogeysiin
eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Waddamada qaar ayaa leh xeer ciqaabeedyo aad u daran oo loogu talagalay xitaa dambiilayaasha markii ugu horeysay danbiga galay; kuwaas waxa ka mid noqon karaa xarig ka badan 10 sannadood ama dil.
eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Shandadaha aan lala joogin waxa soo beegsan kara tuugada iyo sidoo kale qolyaha maamulka ee ka warwarsan khatar miino.
eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Markaad guriga joogto, la kulankaaga joogtada ah ee jeermisyada deegaanka dartiisa, waxa aad u suurtogala inaad horeyba uga tallaalantay iyaga.
eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Balse meelaha kale adduunka, kuwaasoo batkeeriyadeedu kugu cusub tahay, aad bay u badan tahay inaad mushkilad kala kulanto.
eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Sidoo kale, cimilooyinka kulul bakteeriyadu si degdeg ah ayay u kortaa waxaanay debedda ku noolaan kartaa muddo dheer jidhka dibaddiisa.
eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Sidaa daraaded ciqaabti Delhi Belly, Habaarki Fircoon, Aarsigii Montenzuma iyo saaxibadoodi badnaa.
eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Sida ay uga jiraan dhibaatooyin neefmarineed cimilooyinka qaboow, ayay dhibaatooyin xiidmeed ugu jiraan dhulalka kulul kuwaas runtii dhib badan balse aan sidaas u khatar badnayn.
eng_text: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Hadii aad u safrayso waddan soo koraya markii ugu horeysay - ama qayb cusub oo adduunka ka mida - ha yaraysan fajacisooyinka dhaqan.
eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Musaafiriin badano ladan ayaa waxa ka tan badiye kobaca cusub joogtada ee safarada, kuwaaso isbadalka hab dhaqan ee yar yar ay aad u kordhi karaan markiiba.
eng_text: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Kaasatan maalmamaahii hore, waxaad tixgalisaa istaylka reer galbeedka iyo tayada huteelada, cuntada, iyo adeegyada caawimaada.
eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Ha ku seexan furaash ama salli yaal dhulka meelaha aanad aqoon u lahayn xayawaanka deegaanka.
eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Haddi aad xero aad aadeyso soo qaado gogol yar ama shabaqa hurdo ee geedaha lagu xirto si ay kaag ilaaliyan masaska, daba qalooca iyo waxii lamida.
eng_text: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Guriga ka buuxso kafee qaniya subaxii habeenkiina waxooga shaah dajiye jamomayla ah.
eng_text: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Markii aad fasax gasho, waxaad helaysaa waqti aad isku daawaynayso oo aad waqti xoogaa ah ku qaadanayso inaad samayso wax gaar ah.
eng_text: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Hadii aad inaad wax tijaabiso diyaar u tahay, cabbitaan fursad sii ama isku qas burcad qudaareed.
eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Waxa laga yaaba inaad hesho sharaab sahlan oo aad quraac ka dhigan karto markaad ku laabato noloshaadi maalilaha ahayd.
eng_text: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Hadii aad ku nooshahay magaalo dhaqan cabitaan kala duwan, tag baararka ama pubs xaafadaha kale ee inta badan aadan tagin.
eng_text: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Kuwiina aan aqoon kelmadaha caafimaad, kelmadaha caabuq leh iyo saf-mareen waxay leeyihiin macnoyaal kala duwan.
eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Cudur caabuqeed waa mid uu keenay jeermis-side sida fayras, bakteeriyo, fangas, ama dulin kale.
eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Cudur faafa waa cudur si hawl yar la isugu gudbin karo hadii aad u dhawaato agagaarka qof sadhaysan.
eng_text: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Dawlado badan ayaa doonayo martida soo galayso, ama dadkooda ka baxaayo wadankooda laga talaalo xanuuna kala duwan.
eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Shuruudahaas waxa laga yaabaa inay waxoogaa ku xirnaadaan waddanka ama safruhu uu booqday ama uu rabo inuu booqdo.
eng_text: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Mid ka mid ah barta Charlotte, ee Waqoyiga Carolina, waxay leedahay kala doorashooyin tayadooda aad u sarey oo ay heli karaan qoysaska.
eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Dadka deegaano kale ka yimaadeen ayaa sheegaan in u ficnaanta qoyska ay tahay sababta aasaasiga oo meesha loogu soo guuro, iyo in martida ay u arkaan magaalada inay aad ugu fiicaan tahay baashaalka caruurta oo dhaw.
eng_text: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: 20kii sano ee la soo dhaafay, xaddiga xulashooyinka u roon caruurta ee farshaxan magaalaha Charlotte ayaa si weyn u kobacday.
eng_text: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Guud ahaan qoysaska Jaarloot degani ma adeegsadaaan tagaasida, in kastoo ay waxtar yeelan karaan xaaladaha qaar.
eng_text: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Waxaa jirta lacag dulsaar marka ay wixii ka badan laba dadka rakaabka, doorashadan waxay noqon karta mid aad qaali u hadan laga maarmaan ah.
eng_text: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Anta aartika waa meesha ugu qaboow Dhulka, waxayna ku wareegsan tahay Cidhifka Koonfureed.
eng_text: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Boqashada dalxiisku waa qarash, waxay u baahan tahay jir ahan inad dhisnaato, hal meel ayad ku qaadan kartaa xaagaga bisha Novermber ilaa February waa meesha ugu weyn Peninsula, Jasirada iyo Bada Ross.
eng_text: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Laba kun oo shaqaale ah ayaa xagaagii halkan ku noolaada iyagoo dega afar dersin oo saldhig oo badankoodu aaggan ku yaaliin; tiro yar ayaa jilaalkii sii joogta.
eng_text: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Dhulka Antaartika waa taag go'an oo uu dabuulay 2-3 km oo barafa.
eng_text: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Takhasuslyaal ku dalxiisa dhanka hawada ayaa marmar u aada dhanka oogada buuro koris ama si ay u gaaran cirifka halkaas oo saldhig wayni ku yaallo.
eng_text: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Gudubka (Laamida) Cidhifka Koonfureed waa waddo 1600 km oo ka bilaabanta Istaanka McMurdo ee ku yaal Badda Ross illaa iyo Cidhifka.
eng_text: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Waa baraf adkaday oo dalooladiisu buuxaan laguna calaamadiyay calamo. Waxa mari kara oo keliya cagafyo gaar ah, kuwaasoo alaabooyin shidaal meesha ku qaada.
eng_text: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Kuwaasi maaha qaar aad u dheereeya markaas waddadu waxay aad ugu wareegtaa Buuraleyda Transantarctic si ay u soo korto taagga.
eng_text: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Waxyaalaha ugu caansan ee keena shilalka jilaalkii waa waddooyinka sibibixa ah, marmarka (waddo dadeed) iyo jaranjarooyinka.
eng_text: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Ugu hooseyn, waxaad u baahan tahay kabo sar ku habboon leh. Kabaha xagaagu badanaa waa qaar ku dul sibibixda barafka iyo qabawga, kuwaaso xitaa buudhadhka jiilaalku qaarkood aanay lahayn.
eng_text: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Sharaxaadu waa inay qoto ku filan lahaataa, 5 mm ( 1/5 inji) ama ka badanba, shaygu waa inay jileec ku filan yeeshaa meelah heerkulka qaboow.
eng_text: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Kabaha qaar ayaa leh furuuruc waxaana jira qalab lagu kordhiyo oo isna furuuruc leh looguna talo galay meelaha sibiibixanaya, kuwaaso ku habboon kabaha iyo buudhka intooda badan, cidhbaha ama cagta hoose ee kabta.
eng_text: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Ciribta waa in ay hoseysa ayna balarata. Ciida, Jayga ama milixda/cusbada (kaloriinta kaalshiyta) badana waxaa laga hela iyagoo daadsan wadooyinka si kor lagu qaado jaritaanka.
eng_text: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Daadadku ma ahan wax aan Caadi aheyn ;Jiiraha dhaadheer waxay hayn karaan baraf aad u badan, wixii ku dheeraadana way soo butaacinayaan.
eng_text: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Dhibaatadu waa in barafku isjiid-jiito, markaas waxa uu u baahanyahay wax dhaqaajiya si uu u soo dhaco, barafka soo dhacayaana kicin u noqon kara inta hartay.
eng_text: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Mararka dhacda asalka ah ee wax bilaabaysaa waa diirimaadka barafka, mararka qaarna baraf dheeraada oo soo dhaca, marar kalena waa dhacdooyin kale oo dabiici ah, badaan qaar aadami ah.
eng_text: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Duufaantu waa tiir wareegaya oo how cadaadis hoose leh ah, taasoo hawada ku hareeraysan dhanka gudaha iyo kor u nuugta.
eng_text: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Waxa ay soo saaran dabeyl heer sareysa (inta badan 100-200 meyl/saacadi) waxa ayna sii qaadan karaan walxo culus inta ay duufantu socoto.
eng_text: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Waxay ku bilaaben tuunbo lagagudbinayo daruuraha dabeesha waxayna noqotay “taluuliye” marka ay taabtan dhulka.
eng_text: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Bixinta VPN shakhsi ah (leh khadka gaarka u ah qofka) ayaa ah hab aad u wanaagsan kuna haboon kala saarista xaladaha siyaasada iyo ganacsiga labadaba.
eng_text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Dhowr sababood ayay kaga fiican yihiin websayd beenaadyada: waxay dib u jiheeyaan dhammaan saxmadda internetka, keliya maaha http.
eng_text: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Caadiyan waxay baxshaan xawaare intan ka dheer iyo adeeg ka tayo fiican. Way xaffidan yihiin markaas way adag tahay in la basaaso.
eng_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Badanaa shirkadaha warbaahinta waxay ka been sheegaan ula jeedada , iyago ku andacoonayo “ilaa linta sirta qofka”.
eng_text: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Xaqiiqatan, koodadka gobaladu haba yaraatee wax saamayna kuma leh nuqulaynta sharci darrada ah; nuqulayn xabbad-xabbada ah ee cajaladu caadi bay ugu daarmaysaa aalad kasta ta asalka ahi ku daarmi lahayd.
eng_text: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: U jeedada saxda ah ayaa ah in shirkadani aad loogu maamulo suuqyadooda; kaliya waa lacag wareejin.
eng_text: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Maadaama wicitaanda la dhex mariyo khadka, uma baahnid inaad isticmaasho shirkad taleefan ku taal halkaad ku nooshahay ama meeshaad u safrayso.
eng_text: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Sidoo kale ma jirto wax shuruud ah oo ah inaad ka hesho lambar bulshada deegaanka aad ku nooshahay; ayda Chicken iyo Alaska waxaad ka heli khadka satalaytka kaasoo sheegaya inaas joogto Arizonada qorraxda miidhan ah.
eng_text: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Inta badan, waa inaad u iibsataa lambar caalami si gaara kaasoo ogolaanaya in taleefanada PSTN ku soo wacaan. Halka lambarku ka imanayo macno ayay u samaynaysaa cidda ku soo wacaysa.
eng_text: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: App markiiba kuu turumaya qoraalka - borograam yada awooda in ay jumlad buuxdo kuu turjumaan si automatic ah luuqad ka luuqad.
eng_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Barnaamijyada ku jira qaybtan qaarkood waxay xitaa turjumi karaan qoraal luuqad qalaad ah oo ku qoran calaamaso ama ashyaa dhulka yaal marka isticmaaluhu taleefankiisa casriga ah dhanka walxahaas u jeediyo.
eng_text: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Mishiinada turjumistu aad bay uga soo reeyeen, haddana waxay soo saaraan turjumis ku dhawaad sax ah ( oo marar dhif ah waxaan la fahmayn ah), balse daryeel ayaa soo socda, maadaama laga yaabo weli inay waxoo dhanba khaldaan.
eng_text: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Barnaamijyada ugu caansan ee qaybtan ka tirsan waxa ka mida Google Translate, kaasoo ogolaada turjumista bilaa khadka ah ka dib markaad la soo degto xogta luqadaad rabto.
eng_text: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Isticmaalka barnamiijyada tilmaamo bixiya yaal ee GPS-ka taleefankaga ayaa noqon kara kuwa ugu fudud uguna wanaagsan ee aad ku socdaali karto marka aad ka maqan tahay dalkaaga hooyo.
eng_text: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Waxay lacag ku badbaadin kartaa iibsasashada khariirado cusub oo loogu tala galayu GPS,ama aaladda GPS ee taagan ama mid lagu kireysto shirkada kirada baabuurta.
eng_text: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Hadii aanu khad kuugu xirnayn moobilkaaga, ama marka uu ka baxo aagiisa, shaqadoodu way xaddidmaysaa ama lamaba helayo.
eng_text: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Dukaan kasta waxa ka kiilan taleefano kaadhadh ku shubasho oo talefoon kuwaaso loo adeegsan taleefanada lacagta aha ama kuwa caadiga ah.
eng_text: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Inkastoo kaararka badi ay ku fiican yihiin in lagu waco meel walbo, kuwa qaar ayaa ku takhasuso inay koox wadamo gaar ah qiimo jaban lagu waco.
eng_text: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Helista adeegyadan waxa loo adeegsan karaa taleefan lambar bilaasha kaasoo laga soo wici karo taleefanada badankooda iyadoon wax lacag ahi kugu soconeyn.
eng_text: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Xeerarka la xidhiidha sawirqaadaha ayaa sidoo kale lagu dabaqi karaa duubita muuqaalka, waxaa sidoo kale jiri kara suurto galo kaboo badan.
eng_text: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Haddii in sawir shay laga qaado aan la ogolayn, haddaba haba isku dayin inaad muuqaal ka duubtana.
eng_text: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Hadii aad adeegsanayso kamarada duusha, horey ka sii hubso waxa laguu ogolyahay inaad duubto iyo ogolaanshiyaha ama shatiyada dheeraadka ah ee layska rabo.
eng_text: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Inaad kamarada duusha dul mariso madaar ama lagu buuqsan yahay waa fikrad aan fiicnayn, xitaa hadii ay sharci ka tahay halkaad joogto.
eng_text: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Maalmahan ku safarka diyaaradda ayaa si naadir ah loga hagaajistaa shirkadda diyaaradda inta ega hore la baarin ka dib na la isu barbar dhigin qiimaha.
eng_text: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Marmar qaar isla diyaaradda ayaa qabi karto dhawr qiimo oo aad u kala duwan waxaana muhiim ah inaad isubarbar dhigto natiijooyinka baaritaankaada iyo inaad eegtid bogga internetka ee diyaaradda nafteeda intaadan qabsanin kursi.
eng_text: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: In kasta oo laga yaabo inaadan uga baahneyn fiiso booqashooyinka gaagaaban oo Wadamada qaar sida dalxiis ama basas loo raaaco, u tagista arday caalami ah guud ahaan waxay u baahan tahay sii joogitaan ka dheer halka loo aado sida dalxiis Caadi ah.
eng_text: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Guud ahaan, joogista waddan ajanabi muddo dheer waxay kaaga baahan tahay inaad fiiso horey ka sii hesho.
eng_text: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Fiisayaasha ardaydu guud ahaan waxay leeyihiin shuruudo iyo habraac ka duwan kuwa dalxiisa caadiga ah iyo kuwa ganacsiga.
eng_text: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Waddamada intooda badan, waxaa laga rabaa inaad waraaq aqbalaad ka haysato machadka aad wax ka baran lahayd, iyo sidoo kale caddayn tusinaysa inaad haysato qarashkaad wax ku baran lahayd ugu yaraan sannadka ugu horeeya ee kooraskaaga.
eng_text: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Ka hubso xarumaha,iyo sidoo kale waaxda socdaalka ee Wadanka aad rabto inaad wax ka barato shuruudaha oo faahfaahsan.
eng_text: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Inaad ba safiir tahay maogi, ka shaqaynta qurbaha ayaa sida guud micneheedu tahay inaad ku qasban tahay inaad buuxisid canshuurta wadanka aad degan tahay.
eng_text: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Canshuurta soo lagaha mushaariga waxa ay u habeysan tahay qaabab kala duwan waddan walba, heerka canshuurtuna waa uu kala duwan yahay wadan walba.
eng_text: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Waddamada federaalka ah, sida Maraykanka iyo Kanada, cashuurta dakhliga waxa lagu qaadaa heer federaal iyo mid deegaan labadaba, maraas heerarka iyo qaybuhu way u kala duwanayaan gobolada.
eng_text: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Iyadoo baadhista waaxda socdaalku ay maqan tahay amase ay iska habraac tahay markaad ku soo laabanayso waddankaaga, waaxda kaantaroolka cashuuraha yaa dhib noqon karta.
eng_text: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Hubso inaad ogtahay waxa aad soo qaadan karto iyo waxa aadan soo qaadan karin kuna dhawaaqwax kasta oo ka baxsan xadka sharciga.
eng_text: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Habka ugu sahlan ee aad ku bilaabayso ganacsi qoraal safareed waa inaad kobcisaa xirfadahaaga oo aad samaysato websayd safar.
eng_text: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Marka aad noqoto mid xasiloon adigoo ku saleynayoakhidada sidoo kale diyaarinayo websaydh k, hodhow, waxaad sameyn kartaa websaydh aad adigu leedahay.
eng_text: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Mutadwacnimo ku shaqaynta adoo safraya waa qaab fiican oo aad isbeddel ku samayn karto balse maaha bixin kaliya.
eng_text: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Ku noolaanshaha iyo tabaruc kaga shaqaynta waddan ajaanib waa qaab fiican oo aad ku baran karto dhaqan kale, kula kulmayso dad cusub, naftaada aad ku baranayso, oo aad ku helayso dhinac kale oo wax laga arko oo xitaa aad ku baran karto xirfad cusub.
eng_text: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Waxa sidoo kale fiiican in dakhliga la ballaariyo si ay u sahasho in meel waqti dheeraada la sii joogi karo maadaama shaqooyin badan oo mutadawacnimo ahi qollaal iyo mushahar yar bixiyaan.
eng_text: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Vikings waxay adeegsadeen biyaha Ruushka si ay u gaadhaan Badda Madaw iyo Badda Kasbiyaanka. Qaybo ka mid ah waddooyinkaas ayaa weli la adeegsan karaa. Eeg bal in loo baahan yahay ruqsado khaas ah, kuwaaso ay adkaan karto in la helo.
eng_text: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Badda Caddaanka-Baltic-ga waxay isku xirtaaa Badweynta Arctic Ocean ilaa Badda Baltic,Iyada oo loo sii maro Harada Onega,Harada Ladoga iyo Saint Petersburg,inta badan webi iyo harooyin.
eng_text: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Harada Onega waxay sidoo kale ku xiran Folga, markaas in laga soo baxo Badda Kasbiyaanka iyadoo la soo marayo Ruushka wali waa suurtogal.
eng_text: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Hubi in isla markaad tagto dekedaha wax kasta waadax buu noqonayaa. Waxaad la kulmi doontaa dadka kale oo doomaha raaca warkoodana way kula wadaagi doonaan.
eng_text: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Asliyan waxaad dhejin doontaa ogaysiisyo aad ku fidinayso taageeradaada, waxaad tallaabsan doonta sagxadda dekedda, la hadli doontaa dadka nadiifinaya maraakiibtooda, waxaad isku dayi doontaa inaad la xiriirto bad-maaxyada baarka jooga, iwm.
eng_text: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Isku day inaad la hadasho tirada dadka ee ugu badan. Waxoogaa ka dib qof kastaa wuu ku ogaanaya wuxuna ku siinayaa talo ku saabsan doonta raadinaysa qof.
eng_text: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Waa in aad si taxaddar leh u doorataa duulimaadyada Flyer-kaaga soo noqnoqda.
eng_text: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: In kastoo laga yaaba inaad filato inay fiican tahay inaad ku biirto diyaarada aad ku duusho inta ugu badan, waa inaad ogaataa xuquqaha la baxsho way u kala duwan yihiin badanaa meelaha loo duulayo waxaana laga yaaba inay ku badan yihiin diyaarado kale oo isla kaashiga ku jira.
eng_text: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Diyaaradaha sida Imaraati, Diyaaradda Itixaad, Diyaarada Qatar, & Diyaaradaha Turkish waxay si fiican ugu fududeeyeen adeegyadoodii Afrika, waxaanay baxshaan adeegyo isku xidha magaalooyin waawayn oo Afrika ku yaal kuwaaso qiimo macquula leh marka loo eego diyaaradaha Reer Yurub.
eng_text: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Diyuuradaha Turkida ayaa u duula 39 meel ee 30 dal Afrikaana 2014.
eng_text: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Hadii aad haysato waqti dheeraada, bal eeg sida wadarta guud ee noolkaaga Afrika ugu dhigmo noolka adduunka lagu soo wada wareegayo.
eng_text: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Ha ilaawin in aad ku darto lacagaha dheeriga fiisoyinka dheeriga, canshuurta bixitaanka, gaari raaca dhulka, iwm. dhamaan meelaha Africa ka banaanka.
eng_text: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Hadaad dooneysid inaad diyaarad ku tagto aduunka dhamaan geeska Koonfuureed ee Aduunka, dooqyada diyaaradaha iyo meelaha ay u baxayaan ayaa u xadidan la’aanta wadooyin dul maraayo badaha.
eng_text: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Ma jirto diyaarada isaga gudubta saddex dariiq ee badwaynta ee ku yaal Dhulka Badhkiisa Koonfureed ( Kooxda Sky iyana ma marto waddooyinka midkoodna).
eng_text: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Hase ahaatee, Star Alliance waxay koobtaa wax kasta marka laga reebo bariga Koonfurta Baasifikada laga bilaabo Santiago de Chile ilaa Tahiti, kuwaasoo ah duulimaad LATAM Oneworld.
eng_text: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Duulimaadkani doorka keliya ee aad haysato maaha hadii aad rabto inaad ka tagto Baasifia Koonfureed iyo xeebta galbeed Koonfur Ameerika. ( eeg xagga hoose)
eng_text: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: 1994 kii, gobolka Armiiniya ka soo jeeda ee Nagorno-Karbakh ee Azerbaijan ayaa dagaal ku qaaday Azeriska.
eng_text: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Soo labashada dadka Armenian, waxaa la sameyey jamhuur cusub. Si kasto ay ahaato lama aas aasing qaran – xita Armenian – si rasmiyan loma aqoonsan.
eng_text: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Muran siyaadeed ka dhashay gobolka ayaa waxyeeleeyay xiriirka ka dhexeeya Armiiniya iyo Azerbaijan.
eng_text: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Degmada Kanaal (Dutch: Grachtengordel) waa degmo caan ah oo jirtay qarnigii 17aad oo ku wareegsanayd Binnestad ka Amsterdam.
eng_text: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Degmada oo dhan waxa loogu aqoonsaday inay tahay Goobaha Asaarta Adduunka ee UNESCO qiimaheeda dhaqan iyo taariikheed ee gaarka ah, qiimaha dhismayaasheeduna waa kuwa ugu qaalisan waddanka.
eng_text: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terra, oo la macno ah Shan Dhul, wuxu ka kooban yahay tuulo xeebeed yar oo ku taal Romaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza iyo Monterosso kuwaasoo ku yaal gobolka Talyaanig ee Liguria.
eng_text: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Waxay ku diiwansan yihiin Liiska Aasaarta Aduunka ee UNESCO.
eng_text: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Qarniyo badan, dadku waxay si taxaddar lehuga dhiseen jidhaamo dhulkoodii qorfaha ahaa, ee jiirta dheer ahaa kaasoo dusha ka eegaya badda.
eng_text: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Soo jidashadiisa waxaa kamida muuqasho la'aanta horumar wada jir. Wadooyin, tareeno, iyo doomo ayaa taga xaafada laakin baaburta dibada kama soo geli karaan.
eng_text: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Nooca Faransiiska ee lagaga hadlo Biljam iyo Switzerland waxyar buu ka duwan yahay ka lagaga hadlo Faransiiska, in kastoo ay isku dhaw yihiin illaa heer la wada fahmi karo.
eng_text: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Gaar ahaan, nidaamka tirooyinka ee Biljamka iyo Switzerland ta ku hadasha Faransiisku waxa uu leeyahay qaabyar oo waxyar ka duwan Luuqadda Faransiiska ee Faransa lagaga hadlo, ku dhawaaqista kelmadaha waxyar bay duwan tahay.
eng_text: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Si kastaba ha noqotee, dhamaan dadka ku hadla luuqada Faransiis ka ee Belgian iyo Swiss waxay aheyd in ay bartaan heerka Faransiiska ee iskuul kooda, si ay u awoodaan iney fahmaan haddii ay doonayaan iney fahmaan xeerka tirade ee Faransiiska
eng_text: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Meelo badan oo adduunka ka mida, gacan taagu waa ishaaro saaxiibtinimo oo la macno ah "marxabba".
eng_text: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Si kasta haba ahaate, Malaysia gudahed, Maleysiyaanka, meelaha miyiga dagan, waxa ay ula macno tahay "Kaalay imanow," si lamida farta hore oo hoos loo qaloociyo, ficil wadamada Galbeedka qaar laga isticmaalo, loona isticmaalo ujeedadas lee.
eng_text: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Sidoo kale, safareey Ingiriis oo Spain ku sugan ayaa ku qaldami karo gacanta loogu haadinaayo macasalaamo oo gacanta kusoo jeedo qofka haadinaayo (inta ay ku jeedi lahayd qofka loo haadinaayo) uu na u fahmo in logu yeerayo inuu soo noqdo.
eng_text: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Luuqadaha kaalmaynta ayaa ah luuqado la sameeyey oo loo abuuray inay u fududeyaan isgaarsiinta dad ay wada gaarsiintu ku adkaan lahayd.
eng_text: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Way ka baxsan yihiin Lingua Francas, oo ah luuqad dabiici ama asal ah taaso awood ku yeelatay sababuun noqontayna habka ay ku wada xiriiraan dadka ku hadla luuqado kale.
eng_text: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Kuleelka maanta, dadka safrayo waxay la kulmaan mucjisoyin kuwaas oo ku tusayo muqaalo sida biyaha (ama wax yaabo kale).
eng_text: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Kuwan ayaa ahaan karo halis haduu socdaha iska dawa galo saxansaxada, halkaasi na ku khasaariyo awoodiisa muhiimka ah iyo biyaha u dhiman.
eng_text: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Xataa saxaraha ugu kulul ayaa noqon karaa mid aad iyo aad u qaboow habeenki. Barafow (Hypothermia) waa halis xaqiiq ah hadaadan wadan dhar ku kululeeya.
eng_text: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Xiliga jilaalka, qaastan, hadii aar rabto inaad korto keymaha roobleyda waa in aad iska ilaalisa kaneecada
eng_text: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Xataa haddii aad dhex mareyso keymaha roobka ee sabtrobikalka, dhoor sikin oo albaabada furto si aad gaariga u gasho ayaa ku filan in kaneeco ay gasho gaariga.
eng_text: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Hargabka shimbiraha ama hargabka afiyaan ka, wuxuu sameyn kara shimbiraha iyo xayawanada naasleyda.
eng_text: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Wax ka yar kun kiis ayaa bini aadamka lagu arkay, balse qaar ka mid ah ayaa khatar ah.
eng_text: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Badankoodu waxay la xiriireen dad ka shaqaynayay dhaqashada digaaga, balse waxay sidoo kale khatar ku yihiin shimbiro daawadayaasha.
eng_text: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Sida caadiga ka ah Norwayn waa godad iyo dooxooyin dhaadheer kuwaasoo markiiba ku baxa bannaano sare.
eng_text: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Taagagaas waxa badanaa lagu tilmaamaa “vidde” oo la macno ah dhul bannaan, furan dhir la’, oo bilaa xuduud ah.
eng_text: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Rigoland iyo Agder waxa badanaa caadiyan looga yaqaano “hei” taasoo la macno dac bilaa dhir ah oo ay ris dabooshay.
eng_text: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Baraf-cagaarku ma xasiloona,laakin buurta ayuu hoos uga soo qulqula.Tani waxay sababi kartaa dildilaacyo, dillaacyo, kuwaasoo laga yaabo inay qariyaan buundooyinka barafka.
eng_text: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Gidaarada iyo saqafka godadka barafku way dumi karaan dillaacyaduna way xirmi karaan.
eng_text: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Geftinka berkad barafeedka waxa ka soo jabi lakab wayn, oo hoos u soo dhaca lagana yaabaa inuu ka boodo geftinka ama giraangiroodo.
eng_text: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Xilli dalxiiseedka istaamada buuruhu waxa uu heerka ugu sarreeya gaaraa inta badan inta lagu jiro xagaaga Hindiya.
eng_text: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Si kastoo ay ahaataba, waxay leeyahiin qurux kala duwan iyo farxad xiliga jilaalka, bosteeojoyin badan waxay heelan tiro caafirmad xiliga barafka iyo ku deeqid shaqooyin sida ciyaaraha baraf ka.
eng_text: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Shirkado diyaarado yar ayaa wali bixiyaan qiimaha geerida, oo waxyar dhimaayo kharashka safarta daqiiqada ugu dambe.
eng_text: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Diyaaradaha bixiya kuwan waxaa kamida ta kanada,diyaarada Delta, Lufthansa duulimaadyada ka imanaya U.S ama Kanada, iyo WestJet.
eng_text: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Si walbaba, waa inaad boos ku qabsatid adigoo si toos ah telefoon ugu diraysid shirkadda diyaaradda.
eng_text: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
